upsell.title: Adobe-trusted signatures
upsell.devSeal: This deployment seals completed envelopes with a demo certificate, so Adobe Acrobat reports the signatures as untrusted.
upsell.pitch: With OpenFilz Cloud Signing, envelopes are sealed with OpenFilz's Adobe-approved (AATL) certificate — signatures show as valid in Acrobat, for €1 per user per month. Only a document hash ever leaves your deployment.
upsell.byoc: Prefer your own identity? Bring your own AATL certificate (PKCS#12 file or Azure Key Vault HSM) — the AATL Onboarding Pack guides you from purchase to first sealed PDF.

ee.pitch: As an Enterprise customer, OpenFilz Cloud Signing is available as an option on your subscription (+€1 per user per month): envelopes are sealed with OpenFilz's Adobe-approved (AATL) certificate and signatures show as valid in Acrobat. Only a document hash ever leaves your deployment.

smartFiling.title: Smart filing
smartFiling.description: When you ask for it, OpenFilz files the documents you upload into the folder that fits them best. You can always move a document back.
smartFiling.letOpenfilzChooseHint: Uploaded documents are filed into the folder that fits them best, inside the folder you upload to. You can move them back at any time.

info.title: How smart filing works
info.subtitle: What OpenFilz does with your uploads when “Let OpenFilz choose the folder” is on.
info.personalTitle: Your setting, for all your uploads
info.personal: These switches are yours alone: they change nothing for other users. They apply to every upload you make, whatever the folder.
info.scopeTitle: Documents stay in the folder you upload to
info.scope: OpenFilz files a document into the folder you upload it to, or into one of its sub-folders — never anywhere else.
info.scopeRoot: Upload at the root of My Folder and OpenFilz may file it anywhere in your library.
info.scopeRootOrInbox: Upload at the root of My Folder, or into your Inbox, and OpenFilz may file it anywhere in your library.
info.newFoldersTitle: New folders only if you allow it
info.newFolders: With “May create new folders” on, OpenFilz creates a folder when no existing one fits — always inside the folder you upload to.
info.unsure: If OpenFilz is not confident, or a file with the same name is already there, the document stays where you dropped it. Nothing is ever overwritten or renamed.
info.undoTitle: You can always move it back
info.undo: Use “Undo” in the message shown after the upload, or “Move back” on the “Filed by OpenFilz” label in the document details.
